reuse.why: The rule change is made inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper, which all schedule consumers already call.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the range and tolerance rules are each a single expression in the helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the tree already defines it; callers only get comment updates.

scope.why: Only the helper, its tests and stale comments at the call sites are touched.

maintainability.why: Math.min and amount - tolerance express 'lowest allowed value' directly and are easy to own.
